title: Probar heartbeat 3m y recovery 6/10m sin duplicar autoridad
mission: Independently test the new worker liveness policy: visible launch beacon, assignment PIN/claim before substantive work, heartbeat/checkpoint freshness, STALE_SUSPECT at 6 minutes, RECOVERY_ELIGIBLE at 10 minutes, deterministic next-generation recovery, and loser re-entry without duplicate execution. Use safe fixtures or isolated candidate work; do not create unsafe overlapping writes merely to satisfy timing.
definition_of_done: Beacon and heartbeat schemas are exercised with durable evidence.
A fresh signal younger than 6m blocks time-only recovery.
A 6-10m silent fixture is projected as suspect but not recovery winner.
A >=10m silent retry-safe fixture permits exactly one next-generation recovery winner.
Recovery losers re-enter allocation; no duplicate authority or stale overwrite occurs.
Return exact evidence and any policy defect; do not call production /w operational.
